services.desc: Cruise Lake Union and Lake Washington as you sip on fine wines by Airfield Estates Winery paired with a delicious four-course meal created by our Executive Chef. The team will guide you through the wine tasting as you see the breathtaking views of Seattle from our yacht! About Airfield: Airfield Estates' history began in 1907 with founder H. Lloyd Miller in Sunnyside, Washington. By 1920, he acquired the estate vineyard land and secured irrigation through the Roza Canal Project with President Roosevelt's support. services.desc: Grab your friends and co-workers for a cruise on Lake Union! Check out the sights and relax with your favorite drink in hand as you take in the views of Seattle’s lakes! Book for a group of six or more to save 10 percent off your tickets. Email contact@waterwayscruises.com or call 206.223.2060 for large group bookings. services.name: Halloween Party Cruise
services.desc: Hop on our Halloween Party Cruise on Seattle’s lakes where you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of Seattle by night. Dress to impress in your best costume and join the fun in our onboard Costume Contest, with a chance to win exciting prizes. Get started off with a complimentary greet drink hosted by Waterways, along with delicious appetizers and desserts. The night will be filled with lively music from our DJ, ensuring a dance floor that’s always buzzing. This is a Halloween experience you won’t want to miss—reserve your spot today and get ready for an unforgettable evening on the water.
